coordinateMethod: Original 43 pins from TMB association; 11 additional pins from linked refuge, tourism and specialist mapping sources. No guessed or geocoded coordinates.
routeMethod: All published coordinates preserved from official main, variant and off-GR GeoJSON layers.
distanceMethod: 777 original published directional walking distances retained. Additional map estimates exclude local access paths; unverified access distances are not supplied.
numbering: All 54 stays numbered counterclockwise from Les Houches by nearest main-route progress; tied alternative-route locations follow that alternative.
